title: Implement opt-in automatic retry for idempotent A2A tasks
summary: Add an opt-in retry loop that requeues only tasks marked idempotent after stale leases, records audit evidence for each retry decision, and keeps retry behavior bounded and observable.
expectedFailureModes: Retry automation requeues non-idempotent tasks and causes duplicate external effects.
Retries happen silently without operator-visible audit evidence or attempt counters.
Backoff and max attempts are implicit and lead to runaway retry storms.
verification: cd agent-os && cargo test -p covenantd a2a --locked
humanEscalation: Approval before enabling automatic retry by default or retrying operator_accepted tasks.
nextAction: Implement a bounded retry scheduler for stale leases that requeues only idempotent tasks and emits audit rows describing each retry decision.
